name: wildcard-demo
description: Marley's Wildcard — playable demo (single player vs two bots). Standalone; no Foxfire dependencies.

scripts.sfx: python3 scripts/generate-sfx.py .sfx-wav && for f in .sfx-wav/*.wav; do ffmpeg -v error -y -i "$f" -codec:a libmp3lame -b:a 160k public/audio/$(basename "$f" .wav).mp3; done && rm -rf .sfx-wav
